description: Sustained caloric restriction produces obsessive preoccupation with food, irritability, apathy, social withdrawal and loss of libido - documented since the Minnesota Starvation Experiment and reproduced in every siege since.
energy_note: A mind with one subject left in it.

aspect: Feeding a child you cannot feed
description: The specific injury to a parent is not their own hunger. It is dividing insufficient food in front of children and deciding, daily, who gets less.
energy_note: Arithmetic, performed on your own children.

description: Aid distribution concentrates people in a known location at a known time, which is a recognised and recurring danger. The choice is between hunger and a crowd.
energy_note: Standing in the open because the alternative is hunger.

aspect: The prenatal cohort is created here
description: Maternal malnutrition during a siege produces the exposure documented in the famine-epigenetics literature - see NEU-002. The measurable outcome arrives in fifty years.
energy_note: A siege with a fifty-year receipt.
